Headline: #15 Jeffery Local and #J14 Jeffery Jump Temporary Reroute at Jeffery/83rd
ShortDescription: #15 Jeffery Local and #J14 Jeffery Jump buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions due to street blockage near Jeffery/83rd.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
#15 Jeffery Local and #J14 Jeffrey Jump buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions via Jeffery, South Chicago, 87th, and Jeffery, then resume their normal route, due to street blockage near Jeffery/83rd.

Allow extra travel time.

Headline: Harlem-bound Green Line Delays
ShortDescription: Harlem-bound Green Line trains are running w/major delays following an earlier sick passenger at 47th. Service is resuming, allow extra time.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
Harlem-bound Green Line trains are running w/major delays following an earlier sick passenger at 47th. 

Some trains and platforms may be busier than usual as crews work to restore normal service.

Trains are moving and normal service is being restored.

Allow extra travel time.
